game.name: Satellaview Channel Tuner
game.desc: Launches the Satellaview Channel Tuner, which allows you to update Satellaview+ channels data and see broadcast schedules.\nYou must run this tool before accessing any Satellaview+ content.

game.name: Start Satellaview+
game.desc: Launches the Satellaview+, allowing you to play Satellaview+ content. Run the Satellaview Channel Tuner first to update channels data and see broadcast schedules.
